comment: Manual read at https://flagaudio.com/vcv/prodigal-son.html, which gives the 14kHz to 20kHz band limit, the octave drop taking the band limit with it, the separate noise sustain and the chaos modulation by low-passed white noise. Param 15 Quality (panel Q) and param 16 Waveform (panel WF) have no lines: the maker's own wording gives Digital Overdose, Saw and No Fundamentals, but which switch each belongs to could not be settled, so both were left to fall back to the maker's tooltips. Input 4 Note has no family: the panel pairs it with the NOTE knob the way the DETUNE and MIX jacks are paired with theirs, and there is already a separate V/O input at one volt per octave, so whether it is scaled per octave is unknown and no colour was given. Not settled: whether the amplitude envelope silences the outputs when nothing is patched to GATE. No source is published and the maker's page does not say, so no prerequisite note was written.
